title: Add Tdarr matrix audit harness
summary: Add a developer audit harness for the scratch Tdarr Matrix library, including strict evidence reports and isolated sample-processing runs.
reason: The Tdarr scratch library needs repeatable diagnostics that convert queue, route, source-integrity, and sample-processing evidence into actionable findings.
behavior_before: The generated Tdarr Matrix scratch library could be validated manually, but there was no single tool to audit queue coverage, path containment, source hashes, or sampled SingleFile runs.
behavior_after: A repeatable CLI audits the Tdarr Matrix evidence, can create an isolated sampled run library, and emits JSON, Markdown, and CSV finding reports with strict failure behavior.
manual_validation: tdarr_matrix_audit report --prepare-evidence --prepare-timeout-seconds 30 --report-only - loaded 4632 manifest rows and wrote report; queue snapshot intentionally timed out
rollback_plan: Delete src/mediapipeline/tools/dev/tdarr_matrix_audit.py, tests/python/tooling/test_tdarr_matrix_audit.py, this change packet, and any ignored LocalBase/Scratch/TestLibraries/TdarrMatrixRuns runtime outputs.
notes: Default PowerShell host resolves to pwsh when available and timeout handling terminates the process tree.
